description: AICTIONBOT™ account helper by KULIC Advisory (tool 45). Takes invoice lines (text, amount, supplier) and the chart (SKR03 or SKR04, German standard charts of accounts) and suggests a general ledger account per line from the category of the line, with notes for capitalisation (hardware over 800 euros net, machinery), incidental purchase costs for freight, and travel. Lines with one keyword hit or a special case are marked uncertain; lines without a match have no suggestion. Returns the suggestion per line and the total per account. A suggestion, not tax advice; the business's own chart and tax advisor take priority. Deterministic, no AI, nothing stored. Needs sign-in: runs with an AICTIONBOT™ Werkbank licence; without a licence one check per connection every 30 days is free (sign in with “Connect without a licence”).

language.description: Language of the answer. Default de.

lines.description: Invoice lines: text, amount (net), supplier. German column names work too.
